Healthcare revenue

RCM outsourcing.

Move selected back-office billing work to a partner while keeping clear ownership of patient relationships and approvals.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Start with a controlled pilot

Select a measurable queue such as claim submission, payment posting or aged receivables. Agree the starting position, turnaround targets and review date.

Compare operating models

An in-house, hybrid or full-cycle setup can suit different practices. We document which tasks stay with your staff and which go to the partner team.

Expand with evidence

Review pilot performance in a shared report before adding denial work, eligibility checks or the rest of the cycle. Delivery is in partnership with SuperBillOne LLC.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • A written split of duties between practice and partner.
  • A limited pilot with turnaround measures and a baseline.
  • A handover plan covering ongoing access, notice and data return.
Delivery partner

US healthcare operations.

Cloud Haven coordinates billing work with SuperBillOne LLC, a US-registered medical billing company in Austin, Texas. Your introductory call covers the practice workflow, payer mix and the responsibilities on each side.

Meet the billing partner
Questions

Before you start.

Can we keep patient contact in-house?

Yes. In a hybrid model the practice can retain front-desk and patient-facing work while the partner handles agreed back-office queues.

How do we decide whether to expand a pilot?

Compare its performance against the starting measures and agree what needs to change before adding more stages.

What happens if we end the arrangement?

Notice and data-return terms are discussed before signature, so both sides know how to hand the work back.

Field notes

Further reading.

Scoping a medical billing agreement

Before formal review, make an operational checklist that shows what the billing partner will do and what your practice will retain.

Should your practice outsource medical billing?

A practice can keep billing in-house, hand over one queue or outsource a wider portion of the cycle. Identify the actual capacity gap before selecting a model.
